highlights: AI agents are rapidly expanding into critical enterprise and developer workflows, demonstrated by new open-source security runtimes and advanced tools for automated code review.

Foundational model capabilities continue to break new ground, with GPT-6 demonstrating intrinsic protein design, Z.ai releasing a 750B loop transformer, and Google enhancing real-time video generation.

The developer ecosystem is being fortified with crucial tools like efficient tool retrieval for large agent libraries and low-level GPU control, enabling builders to create more robust and performant AI applications.

agents.title: OpenAI and Cisco Releases Shirudo: Open-Source Linux Runtime for Agent-Based System Defense
agents.summary: OpenAI and Cisco released Shirudo, a BSD-licensed eBPF runtime for Linux, allowing AI agents to deploy signed 'shields' that block exploit paths on running systems, ensuring continuous defense without requiring system downtime for patching.

agents.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Ship for GitHub Pull Request Review and Fixes
agents.summary: Anthropic's Claude Ship bundles Code Review, PR Steward, and Claude Approvals into an agent suite designed to review, fix, and approve GitHub pull requests, significantly streamlining development workflows with automated assistance.

agents.title: AutoPILOT: A Visual Agent Harness for Real-Time Gameplay
agents.summary: AutoPILOT introduces a novel agent harness enabling multimodal foundation models to send primitive actions, initiate open-loop macros, or write closed-loop controllers, significantly improving real-time success rates in dynamic environments like video games by decoupling action generation from model inference frequency.

models.title: GPT-6 Models Demonstrate Intrinsic Protein-Design Capabilities
models.summary: OpenAI's GPT-6 models have showcased the ability to intrinsically design protein structures and sequences, with lab tests confirming evidence of binding across five distinct targets, marking a significant advance in AI for scientific discovery.

models.title: Z AI Releases GLM-5.4: A 750B Loop Transformer That Runs 28 Layers Twice
models.summary: Z.ai released GLM-5.4, a 750B-scale Loop Transformer model designed for deeper reasoning by running its 28 GLM-5 layers twice, with plans for API access and open weights after comprehensive safety evaluations.

models.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and Cost-Effective with Longer Clips
models.summary: Google introduces Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, a new model offering native 15-second video generation and editing capabilities with stronger consistency, all at a 30% lower pricing point, enabling more accessible and advanced multimodal applications.

tools.title: OpenAI and Cisco Introduce Shirudo: Open-Source Linux Runtime for System Defense
tools.summary: OpenAI and Cisco have jointly released Shirudo, an open-source eBPF runtime for Linux, enabling AI agents to construct and deploy 'shields' that proactively block exploit paths on live systems, ensuring protection without disrupting operations during patch deployment.

tools.title: Introducing Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API for Large Tool Libraries
tools.summary: Google AI has launched Tool Retrieval in preview for the Gemini API, enabling developers to equip agents with vast tool libraries and load parameter schemas only when needed, significantly reducing token usage and complexity for sophisticated agentic applications.

tools.title: Meta TLX Brings Warp-Group GPU Control to Triton on Hopper, Blackwell, AMD
tools.summary: Meta introduced TLX (Triton Low-Level Extensions), which provides developers with granular warp-group, barrier, TMA, and cluster control within Python Triton kernels, optimizing high-performance AI workloads on NVIDIA Hopper, Blackwell, and AMD MI350 GPUs.

companies.title: Google Cloud Launches Gemini for Healthcare
companies.summary: Google Cloud has launched Gemini for healthcare, a specialized AI offering designed to unify clinical data and automate complex workflows, aiming to reduce administrative burden and enhance efficiency across healthcare organizations.

companies.title: Google Search Gets a Major Upgrade with Gemini 4 Hydrogen
companies.summary: Google is integrating Gemini 4 Hydrogen globally into Google Search, promising to deliver more helpful, visual, and intuitive search responses, marking a significant evolution in its flagship consumer product.

companies.title: OpenAI and Cisco Introduce Shirudo
companies.summary: OpenAI and Cisco have collaborated to introduce Shirudo, an open-source Linux runtime designed to enhance system security by allowing AI agents to quickly deploy defensive shields against exploits, enabling proactive threat response while patches are being prepared.

learning.title: How to Build and Maintain an Agentic Evaluation
learning.summary: A new guide from Hugging Face Blog provides comprehensive insights into the crucial process of building and maintaining agentic evaluations, offering essential knowledge for developers looking to ensure the robustness and reliability of their AI agents.

learning.title: 27 Cybersecurity Terms to Prepare You for the Age of AI
learning.summary: MarkTechPost offers an informative guide on 27 essential cybersecurity terms, equipping readers with updated vocabulary to navigate the evolving landscape where AI plays a dual role in both perpetrating and defending against sophisticated cyber threats.

learning.title: The Definitive Fine-Tuning Guide for 3D Generation Models
learning.summary: Hugging Face Blog released a comprehensive fine-tuning guide for 3D generation models, providing builders with the knowledge and steps needed to customize and enhance these advanced creative AI systems for specific applications and better performance.
